question: What forecast conditions trigger activation of the heat response?
source_text: The heat response is activated when the forecast high temperature is at least 38°C on two consecutive days, or when the overnight low is forecast to remain at or above 25°C for two consecutive nights. The Emergency Coordination Lead confirms activation and convenes the response team. The Public Health Unit issues heat-safety notices and checks on residents enrolled in its high-risk outreach program. The Facilities Team extends hours at designated cooling rooms and verifies that drinking water and backup power are available.
